title: 【Chinese Culture Immersion】Cultural Exhibition on Fire Dragon Dance in Pok Fu Lam Village 【華夏藝坊】薄扶林村舞火龍文化展覽
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/10/16
»
Events / Activities
【Chinese Culture Immersion】Cultural Exhibition on Fire Dragon Dance in Pok Fu Lam Village 【華夏藝坊】薄扶林村舞火龍文化展覽 - Learning and Cultural Enhancement Section, Office of Student Affairs
From: Viola WU
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
violawu@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
（是次展覽由HK01與薄扶林村火龍會共同主辦，中大作為參與學校之一，支持本地非物質文化遺產的教育與推廣。）
各位同學及同事，
你親身見過一條真正的火龍嗎？
今個十月，一條長逾十五米的火龍將現身中大校園。平日只於中秋巡遊中亮相的火龍，將走進大學圖書館，讓大家近距離欣賞其完整結構與紮作工藝，並認識這項香港非物質文化遺產背後深厚的文化內涵。
「華夏藝坊」
誠邀大家參觀
「薄扶林村舞火龍文化展覽」
。透過展板及實物展示，展覽將帶領大家探索薄扶林舞火龍逾百年的歷史源流、社區故事、紮作技藝及巡遊文化，了解這項傳統習俗如何由地方民俗發展成香港重要的非物質文化遺產。這項百年傳統於2017年列入香港非物質文化遺產代表作名錄，至今仍持續傳承，承載着豐富的地方歷史與社區記憶。
展覽詳情
日期：
2026年10月26日至29日（一至四）
時間：
下午2時至10時（26日）；上午8時20分至下午10時（27日至29日）
地點：
香港中文大學大學圖書館地下
費用：
無需報名，免費入場
誠邀各位到場參觀，探索香港火龍背後的故事、社區歷史與非物質文化遺產之間的深厚連結。
(Co-organized by HK01 and the Pok Fu Lam Village Fire Dragon Association, this exhibition is supported by The Chinese University of Hong Kong as one of the participating institutions, promoting education and awareness of local intangible cultural heritage.)
Dear Students and Staff,
Have you ever seen a real Fire Dragon up close?
This October, a Fire Dragon measuring over fifteen metres in length will be on display at CUHK. Usually seen only during Mid-Autumn Festival processions, the Fire Dragon will be showcased at the University Library, offering a rare opportunity to appreciate its impressive structure and traditional craftsmanship up close, while discovering the rich cultural heritage behind this unique Hong Kong tradition.
As part of the
Chinese Culture Immersion Programme
, you are warmly invited to visit the
Cultural Exhibition on Fire Dragon Dance in Pok Fu Lam Village
. Through exhibition panels and a medium-sized Fire Dragon display, the exhibition traces the century-long history of the Pok Fu Lam Fire Dragon Dance, highlighting its community roots, traditional craftsmanship, and procession culture. Visitors will also learn how this local folk custom has evolved into an important element of Hong Kong's intangible cultural heritage.
Recognized as an item on the Hong Kong Intangible Cultural Heritage Representative List in 2017, the Pok Fu Lam Fire Dragon Dance continues to be passed down from generation to generation, preserving a rich legacy of local history and community memory
Exhibition Details
Date:
26-29 October 2026 (Mon-Thu)
Time:
2:00 pm – 10:00 pm (26 Oct); 8:20 am - 10:00 pm (27-29 Oct)
Venue:
G/F, University Library, CUHK
Admission:
Free admission, no registration required
We warmly invite you to visit the exhibition and discover the stories behind the Fire Dragon, community history, and intangible cultural heritage.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

From: XI HUANG

***Please Note that this study requires reading Chinese words, so we would like to invite students who are native Cantonese speakers to participate.***
教育心理學系謝志成教授一項關於中文複合詞的研究誠意邀請與會者參與。
對象：
**參加者需為粵語是母語的本港學生；
**參與者需要有良好的視力或矯正視力；
**參與者需慣性用右手。
**參與者年齡需大於18嵗。
研究內容：整個實驗將為期三節（每節之間間隔不超過一星期）進行，每節需要 1 至 1.5 小
時，完成3節後可得到250港元作為現金補償。
地點：陳國本樓707E室
參與方式：如有興趣，請點此連結報名https://forms.gle/znR7QB79PVof2F87A
（報名時個人資料包括：姓名、學號、性別、年齡、學系、年級、聯絡電話、聯絡電郵。）
有興趣的同學請按照報名表上的步驟提供時間段，以便安排。
*若閣下沒有收到我們的電郵，代表所選的時間已額滿；
*若已參加過【對於中文複合詞所表達的情感】的研究，請勿重複報名。
如果對實驗有任何疑問，歡迎聯絡xihuang@cuhk.edu.hk

平日門診時段工作

薪酬將按照香港中文大學學生助理時薪標準計算

Requirements:
Fluent Cantonese required
Good communication and interpersonal skills
Mandarin proficiency is an advantage

Weekday outpatient clinic sessions
Work locations include three public hospitals in Hong Kong
Remuneration will follow the standard CUHK student helper hourly rate.

From: CUHK Business School Master's Programmes

Normal Round Admissions for CUHK Business School Master’s Programmes are open, and applications for our three new Master's programmes for the 2027 intake will officially commence in October!
Planning to apply? Join the CUHK Business Master's Webinar Series from 28–30 Oct 2026 and gain first-hand insights from our Associate Dean and Programme Directors.
Date & Time:
28 October 2026 - 30 October 2026
Registration link:
https://cloud.mc.cuhk.edu.hk/202610info?Source=SM140
Webinar Details:
Part 1: 【
Admissions Tips Sharing
】
Discover how to identify the programme that best aligns your goals and strengthen your application strategy, navigate the admissions process and scholarship opportunities, and gain insights into life as a CUHK Business School Master's student.
Date: 28 Oct, 2026 (Wed)
Time: 2:00 PM - 3:00 PM
Speakers:
Prof Waiman CHEUNG
Associate Dean (Graduate Studies), CUHK Business School
Ms Rosanna NG
Manager (Admissions & Marketing), Office of Taught Postgraduate Programmes, CUHK Business School
Part 2:
Hear directly from Programme Directors of our new programmes for 2027 intake —
MSc in Family Business Management, MSc in Sports Business Management, MSc in Global Wealth Management
— as they share about curriculum, career prospects, admissions requirements, and what makes these new programmes distinctive.
【
New Programme Showcase
】
MSc in Family Business Management
Date: 28 Oct, 2026 (Wed)
Time: 4:00 PM - 5:00 PM
Speaker: Prof Victoria WANG
Associate Programme Director, MSc in Family Business Management
【
New Programme Showcase
】
MSc in Sports Business Management
Date: 29 Oct, 2026 (Thu)
Time: 3:00 PM - 4:00 PM
Speaker: Dr Gentiana CHEUNG
Programme Director, MSc in Sports Business Management
【
New Programme Showcase
】
MSc in Global Wealth Management
Date: 30 Oct, 2026 (Fri)
Time: 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM
Speaker: Prof HUANG Guobo
Programme Director, MSc in Global Wealth Management

[Register NOW!]Mastery of Pronunciation and Vocabulary in Putonghua 推廣普通話項目：普通話語匯通（免費參加）！ - Centre for Research and Development of Putonghua Education
From: 香港中文大學普通話教育研究及發展中心
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
pth@fed.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
推廣普通話計劃：普通話語匯通 2026/27
本計劃由語文教育及研究常務委員會（語常會）支持、語文基金撥款

面向本港小四至小六學生，免費參加。
旨在強化並深化學生對普通話語匯的認識，幫助學生把握語匯的語義，感悟其背後的文化底蘊。在創設的情境中，提高學生運用普通話語匯水平，進行有效的口語交際。
2026/27
學年的活動加入全新內容。大部分活動將於香港中文大學校園舉行。
每月設不同活動，包括：講座、親子工作坊、自學活動、參訪活動、情境對話等。
最新活動：
語匯大講堂（一）構詞
日期︰2026年10月24日
時間︰星期六，上午10:00 - 12:00，實體面授，中文大學校園
親親孩子尋語詞 1 食材
日期︰2026年11月28日
時間︰星期六，上午10:00 - 12:00，實體面授，中文大學校園
語匯偵探 1 俗語
日期︰2026年12月18日至31日期間
自學活動，同學將收到自學材料，於舉行期間交回線上工作紙
詳情：
https://www.fed.cuhk.edu.hk/~pth/pth_event.php
網上報名表格：

bodyText:

[Register NOW!] CERTIFICATE IN PRACTICAL TRAINING FOR PUTONGHUA PROFICIENCY TEST（CPSC） 普通話水平測試應試證書課程 - Centre for Research and Development of Putonghua Education
From: 香港中文大學普通話教育研究及發展中心
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
pth@fed.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
普通話水平測試應試證書課程（
CPSC
）（持續進修基金課程編號：38C155714
）
中文大學校園面授
本證書課程以參加國家語委普通話水平測試（PSC）為導向，旨在提高學員普通話應用水平，具體表現為：提高學員普通話朗讀能力，掌握普通話水平測試常用詞匯，掌握朗讀規定篇目的方法，讀準字音，讀通作品。同時，提高學員使用普通話所達到的流利程度和規範程度，掌握普通話水平測試應試的技巧，做好測試前的準備；並幫助參加過測試的應試人進一步提升等級，説話時，逐步做到語音標準，語調自然，表達流暢。本證書課程不是零起點課程，學員須具有基礎普通話能力。
CPSC2027A（
2027
年1
月）
普通話應用訓練 (I) 單元日期︰
2027年1月9日至5月22日（2月6、20日、3月27日、5月1日停課）
普通話應用訓練 (II) 單元日期︰
2027年6月12日至9月25日
時間︰逢星期六，上午9:30 - 12:30
任教導師︰李黃萍 博士（國家級普通話水平測試員）
詳情請瀏覽中心網頁︰
https://www.fed.cuhk.edu.hk/~pth/train_cpsc.php

CPSC）

bodyText:

Announcements
多元文化親子體驗日 Family Cultural Experience Day   - The Jockey Club School of Public Health and Primary Care
From: The Jockey Club S.A.T.H. Project for Healthy Families (JCSATH)
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
jcsath@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
多元文化親子體驗日
想同小朋友一齊認識唔同文化，享受一個充滿樂趣同學習嘅周末嗎？
誠邀您參加 多元文化親子體驗日，透過多元化嘅互動活動，一齊探索南亞文化嘅獨特魅力！
  試穿南亞傳統服飾
體驗特色印度彩繪（Henna）
學習烏爾都語（Urdu）書寫
親子同樂，感受文化多元共融
呢個活動適合家長同小朋友一齊參與，透過輕鬆有趣嘅方式認識南亞文化，促進跨文化交流與理解。
特別獎賞：
首 8位成功報名參加者 可獲精美紀念品一份！
已報名及出席活動嘅12歲以下兒童 可獲發參與證書一張！
日期： 2026年10月18日（星期日）
⏰ 時間： 上午11:30至下午1:00
地點： Quarryside
名額： 20人
歡迎家長及小朋友參加
無需任何相關經驗
輕鬆有趣，適合一家大小
報名連結：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_3OsS8XjXGVdyCLc
查詢： JCSATH WhatsApp 6104 9535
快啲帶埋家人同朋友一齊嚟，透過體驗、交流同互動，感受南亞文化嘅色彩與魅力！
Family Cultural Experience Day
Looking for a fun family activity? Come and explore the rich and vibrant cultures of South Asia through hands-on experiences for both parents and children!
Try on traditional South Asian cultural attire
Experience beautiful henna drawing
Learn to write your name in Urdu
Enjoy a fun and interactive cultural experience together as a family
This is a great opportunity to learn about different cultures, celebrate diversity, and enjoy a meaningful weekend with your children.
Special offers:
The first 8 registered participants will receive a special souvenir!
Registered children under 12 years old will receive a Certificate of Attendance.
Date: 18 October 2026 (Sunday)
⏰ Time: 11:30 AM - 1:00 PM
Venue: Quarryside
Quota: 20 participants
Open to parents and children
No prior experience needed
Fun, family-friendly, and multicultural
Register here:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_3OsS8XjXGVdyCLc
Enquiries: JCSATH WhatsApp 6104 9535
Join us to experience the beauty of South Asian cultures, make new friends, and celebrate cultural diversity together!
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

The Independent Learning Centre (ILC) offers a wide range of workshops and activities to support learning of language and communication skills. Visit our website for more information: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ (20261020)  - ILC
From: ILC
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ilc-counsel@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【Weekly Highlights - English Section 】
A. Communication, Study Skills and Job Preparation Workshops
The Independent Learning Centre offers English workshops 20 October to 23 October: (1) Taking the IELTS Challenge: Reading & Writing, (2) Taking the IELTS Challenge: Speaking & Listening, (3) Hong Kong Civil Service Interview Preparation, and (4) Global Citizenship Series: Global Labour and Employment. These workshops are now available for registration at: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/workshops.aspx
B. Consultation Service in English
Consultation service is available during the following time:
20 October (Tue): 14:30 – 16:30
21 October (Wed): 10:30 – 12:30
22 October (Thu): 10:30 – 12:30
23 October (Fri): 10:30 – 12:30
Online Booking:
https://ilccuhk.as.me/schedule.php
More Timeslot please check our website：
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EH/consultation.aspx
====================================
【Weekly Highlights - Chinese Section 】中文部本週活動
A. Chinese Workshops 中文工作坊
The Independent Learning Centre offers Chinese workshops 20 October to 23 October: (1) JRE Argumentative Writing II, (2) Self- Learning Cantonese II, and (3) Preparation for the JRE: How to write government official letters. These workshops are now available for registration at: https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/workshops.aspx
自學中心十月二十日至十月二十三日舉辦 (1) 「射者正己而後發」——射藝與修身 (粵), (2) JRE 議論文寫作 (二), (3) 自學粵語 (二), 及 (4) JRE政府公函寫作等工作坊，歡迎報名。
登記連結： https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/workshops.aspx
B. Consultation Service in Chinese 自學中心中文輔導服務
Consultation service is available during the following time:
自學中心於十月二十日至十月二十三日提供以下中文輔導時段。
20 October (Tue): 14:30 – 16:30
21 October (Wed): 10:30 – 12:30 and 14:30 – 16:30
網上預約：
https://ilccuhk.as.me/schedule.php
更多中文輔導時段。
====================================
C. “The Power of Words” 「書寫力量」
This is a reading and writing event organized by the ILC, Hong Kong Literature Research Centre, the Office of Arts Administrator (OAA) and Tolopoem. Activities we have this semester include Blackboard / Glass Wall Poems, Talks of Dialogue in the Arts and Workshops.
自學中心、香港文學研究中心、藝術行政主任辦公室及吐露詩社合辦的大型閱讀及寫作活動。這個學期的活動，除黑板詩及玻璃詩外，還有藝文縱談及各式工作坊。各項活動的資料可以參看：https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/Event/thepowerofwords.aspx
====================================
【Independent Online Learning Resources】自學中心網上自學資源
A. Independent Online Learning Resources in English
- Academic Writing
Visit this link on academic writing skills and convention for different citation styles:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/Writing_Writing.aspx
- Vocabulary
Visit this link for both General Vocabulary and Specific Vocabulary (e.g. For Business and Medical Professionals) lists and practices:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/Writing_Vocab.aspx
- Job Search and Interviews
Visit this link to identify your capabilities and personality types, learn how to prepare job search documents and personal statements, and how to get ready for job interviews:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/JobSearching.aspx
B. Independent Online Learning Resources in Chinese中文網上自學材料
- Academic Writing論文寫作
Visit this link for advice on academic writing, with highlights on structure, expressions, common grammatical mistakes, etc.
針對大學生撰寫學術論文時所遇到的困難，提供實用的知識和練習。內容包括：學期論文的結構與寫作步驟、常見語法錯誤、表達與語言邏輯等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/AWOnline/general1.html
- ‘Pulewang’ Online Putonghua Platform「普樂網」網上普通話平台
An online Putonghua learning platform designed for CU students. Essential knowledge of Putonghua is introduced with interactive exercises and games. Extended conversational exchanges on selected topics of social affairs and student life are available for oral practice with texts and pinyin.
針對本校同學學習需要的網上普通話平台，內容圍繞大學生的學習與日常生活，設計深入淺出，每單元均有練習與遊戲，互動有趣，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/Chinese/plw/index.html
- Argumentative Writing議論文寫作
Visit this link for advice on the structure, the content and the language of argumentative writing.
介紹議論文的結構及寫作要求，以解說、例子及練習，呈現寫作議論時要注意的內容及語言特點：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/arguWriting/001.html
- Cantonese Pronunciation粵語拼音速遞
This guide is designed for mainland students as an effective way to learn Cantonese pronunciation. Basic knowledge of Cantonese syllables is introduced with exercises. Comparison of Cantonese and Putonghua pronunciation is also highlighted
協助內地同學迅速掌握粵語發音。內容包括：語音基礎、粵普對比、難點練習等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/cantontones/_home/index.html
- Cantonese Express港式粵語速遞
An interactive introduction to Hong Kong style Cantonese. Daily expressions and situational conversations are introduced with interactive exercises.
以有趣互動的方式介紹港式粵語，包括日常生活用語、情景會話、互動練習等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/canton_express/others/frontpage.html
- Online Cantonese for Foreigners
A free online platform for international students to learn basic Cantonese. The texts are clear and simple, and interactive exercises easy to use: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/can_eng/layout.html
- Online Putonghua for Foreigners
Do you know how to make orders in a Chinese restaurant and learn how to bargain when you travel in China? Here are some situational conversations and basic knowledge of Putonghua to learn online: https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/CHResources/Lang_PTH_EnglishSpk.aspx
- Online Platform for Successful Chinese Learning (OPSCL) 中國語言及文化自學資源網
Online Platform for Successful Chinese Learning (OPSCL) is a biliterate (English and Chinese) online platform that contains reviews of learning materials suitable for autodidactic study in the 5 big areas of Mandarin, Cantonese, Chinese Characters, Chinese Culture, and Hong Kong Culture. Electronic learning materials that is good for self-learning would be review. Each review consists of a description and other useful information. Users can search for resources by various criteria, rate the resources, and write their own comments. A self-assessment system is also provided so as to recommend an entry point to the users according to their current level.

Announcements
[Student Helper Recruitment] Chinese Language and Culture Experience Activities | Cross-cultural Exchange]  - Yale-China Chinese Language Academy
From: Yale-China Chinese Language Academy
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
CLA_UPD@CUHK.EDU.HK
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【學生助理招募】中國語言文化體驗活動｜跨文化交流
雅禮中國語文研習所將於本學期舉辦一系列面向國際學生的中國語言文化體驗活動，主題涵蓋漢字與書法、傳統節慶、手工文化體驗、中文詩歌與文化分享。現誠邀中大學生擔任學生助理，協助活動籌備與現場支援。
活動時間：逢星期五下午，每次兩小時，預計本學期共舉辦5至6次
活動地點：方潤華堂（東鐵線大學站D出口對面）
申請條件：
對跨文化交流充滿熱情，性格開朗，有親和力，具備良好英語溝通能力，並能說標準普通話或粵語；
具備與中華文化相關的才藝，如中國結、詩歌賞析，並樂意與國際學生交流分享；
會編製不同類型的中國結，了解中國結的歷史和種類；
對古詩詞有較為深入的認識，能簡單講解詩詞背景與含義；
懂得古詩詞的押韻、平仄，能簡單從音樂角度賞析詩詞；
會做手工，如拓印、剪紙等的學生獲優先考慮。
待遇：時薪 HKD$67 + 5% MPF
總工作時數：約15小時
有意者請於11月2日前填妥以下表格，合則約見：

報名表格
如有疑問，請聯絡陳小姐：
liyuanchen@cuhk.edu.hk
[Student Helper Recruitment] Chinese Language and Culture Experience Activities | Cross-cultural Exchange]
The Yale-China Chinese Language Academy will host a series of cultural workshops this semester for international students, focusing on themes in Chinese language and culture, including Chinese characters, calligraphy, traditional festivals, handicrafts, poetry, songs, and cultural sharing. We are now recruiting CUHK students to assist with planning and running these events.
Schedule: Friday afternoons, 2 hours per session, approximately 5–6 sessions throughout the semester
Venue: Fong Yun Wah Hall (opposite University Station Exit D)
Requirements:
Passionate about cross-cultural communication, outgoing, friendly, fluent in English, and able to speak Putonghua or Cantonese;
Possess talents or skills related to Chinese culture and be willing to share and interact with international students;
Capable of making Chinese knots and familiar with the history and different types of Chinese knots;
Familiar with classical Chinese poetry and songs and be able to explain the background and meaning;
Understand the rhyme and tone patterns of classical poetry, and be able to offer simple appreciation of poems from a musical perspective;
Priority will be given to students with skills in handicraft such as Chinese rubbing and paper cutting.
Compensation: HKD$67/hr + 5% MPF
Total working hours: Around 15 hours
Interested applicants should complete the form below by November 2. Interviews will be arranged for shortlisted candidates:

Application Form
For inquiries, please contact Miss Chen at
liyuanchen@cuhk.edu.hk
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

禪繞 X 瑪雅印記初探
找回真正的自己快樂做自己
瑪雅印記是什麼？中美洲古瑪雅文明的智慧，說著每個人出生時都有與生俱來的『天賦才華』。此課程將引領你找到『它』，用另一角度認識自己，運用在你的生活/人際關係//工作/家庭中。
「一筆一畫，無限可能。」禪繞是一場筆與紙的自我對話，發現更多未知的自己。不需任何繪畫技巧，沒有對與錯，沒有美與醜，只需筆隨心轉，一筆一畫，療癒心靈，放鬆地繪出自己的世界。
禪繞畫是一種簡單而自由的繪畫技巧，易於入門，可以幫助人們學會專注和集中注意力，並激發創造力和想像力。這些因素都使得禪繞畫成為一種非常適合作為藝術入門的繪畫技巧。
它們都是友善的工具，讓你們禪繞遇見<我的瑪雅, 我的天賦>。

Experiencing Chinese Culture Series 2025–26, organized by Institute of Chinese Studies is arranged from November to December 2026. It is our honour to invite Mr. Ian Huen to deliver a series of talk. This series will be conducted in Cantonese. Feel free to register below.
各位：
香港中文大學中國文化研究所將於十一月至十二月舉辦「
中國文化體驗系列──中國歷史講座：奴才們的囚徒
」。是次課程有幸邀得
禤駿遠先生
主講，
共四節
。誠邀各位參加，詳情如下：
課程簡介：
清聖祖康熙的繼位人之爭，是滿洲八旗中「上三旗」權貴與皇權博弈的延伸。在皇權下的「奴才」們以擁立為名，脅迫君主以維護或擴充自身利益。而眾皇子乃至皇帝，竟然也成為「上三旗」權貴鬥爭的籌碼。皇帝、皇族、八旗子弟、以至滿漢朝臣，均陷入錯縱複雜的角力之中。曾經睿智的皇帝，在暮年會如何為血脈，以至江山社稷作出選擇？且聽禤先生剖析他另闢蹊徑理解的「九子奪嫡」。
導師簡介：
禤駿遠先生
，美國普林斯頓大學經濟學學士，香港中文大學比較及公眾史學文學碩士，北京清華大學高級公共管理碩士。著有The Rising Sons: China's Imperial Succession & The Art of War, What Bruce Lee Didn't Know About Kung Fu and Other Revelations About China, 《你說的是從前——清末與今日中國》及新作《糖衣的國度》。現正於英國牛津大學攻讀博士。

清聖祖康熙的繼位人之爭，是滿洲八旗中「上三旗」權貴與皇權博弈的延伸。在皇權下的「奴才」們以擁立為名，脅迫君主以維護或擴充自身利益。而眾皇子乃至皇帝，竟然也成為「上三旗」權貴鬥爭的籌碼。皇帝、皇族、八旗子弟、以至滿漢朝臣，均陷入錯縱複雜的角力之中。曾經睿智的皇帝，在暮年會如何為血脈，以至江山社稷作出選擇？且聽禤先生剖析他另闢蹊徑理解的「九子奪嫡」。
導師簡介：
禤駿遠先生
，美國普林斯頓大學經濟學學士，香港中文大學比較及公眾史學文學碩士，北京清華大學高級公共管理碩士。著有The Rising Sons: China's Imperial Succession & The Art of War, What Bruce Lee Didn't Know About Kung Fu and Other Revelations About China, 《你說的是從前——清末與今日中國》及新作《糖衣的國度》。現正於英國牛津大學攻讀博士。

The
Office of Student Affairs

Cultural Festival 2026
, themed

”
, a vibrant celebration of cultural diversity, inclusiveness, and connection across borders!

Date:
3 November 2026
Opening Ceremony:
12:30 p.m. to 1:00 p.m.
Booth Exhibition:
12:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m.
Venue:
The Beacon (in front of the University Library)
Opening Ceremony
The event will commence with “
A Dance Journey Across East and West”
, featuring vibrant
Bollywood Dance
and
Kaleidoscopic European Folk Dance performances
. A highlight of the programme will be the spectacular
CUHK Fire Dragon Dance
, which brings an intangible cultural heritage onto the CUHK campus.
Cultural Booths
Throughout the event,
15 cultural booths
hosted by
non-local student associations
and
the
Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages
will also showcase global cuisines, customs and cultural traditions from
more than 25 countries and regions
. The booths include:
Central Asian Association (Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Russia & Uzbekistan)
Indonesian Student Association (Indonesia)
International Connection Programme (Hong Kong)
International Student Association (Japan & Mongolia)
Korean Student Association (Korea)
Mainland Undergraduate Association (China)
Malaysian Students’ Association (Malaysia)
South Asian Student Association of CUHK (Bangladesh, India, Nepal, Pakistan & Sri Lanka)
Southeast Asian Association (Philippines, Singapore, Vietnam)
Thai Student Association (Thailand)
Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages (Austria, France, Germany, Italy, Spain & Switzerland)
Lucky Draw: Visit, Discover and Win!
Register in advance to receive your unique QR code. Simply present it at the designated counter during the event for one chance to enter the lucky draw and win an exciting prize, while souvenirs last.
Prize A (Grand Prize)
: Marshall Emberton III Portable Speaker Sage (1 set)
Prize B:
KODAK Charmera Keychain Digital Camera Blind Box (12 sets)
Prize C:
CUHK-themed Magnetic LED Light Box Blind Box (130 sets)
Prize D:
CUHK Limited Edition Fire Dragon Dance Tote Bag (while souvenir last)
Deadline:
1 November 2026 (first-come, first-served)
Event Details:
Learn More
Lucky Draw Registration:
Here
All are welcome. More details will be shared on our
Instagram
. For enquiries, please feel free to contact us at 3943-1526 or
lces@cuhk.edu.hk
.
Join us to celebrate the richness of global cultures and the spirit of unity!

Office of Student Affairs

From: Esther Qiu

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Recruitment Flyer
Project Title
A cross-cultural perspective on the association between anxiety and independent life skills
What is the study about?
In this study, we are interested in exploring whether and the extent to which independent life skills are associated with problematic behaviours (e.g., alcohol consumption) and mental health challenges (e.g., anxiety)
Who can take part?
You can take part if you are aged 18-25 and an undergraduate student at CUHK and can complete an online English survey independently.
What do we have to do?
You will complete an online English survey include questions about demographic information, educational performance, independent life skills, and mental health. The survey should take approximately 20 minutes.
What will participants receive?
As a token of appreciation for your time, participants will have the opportunity to enter a
PRIZE DRAW
to win a $100 HKD gift card.
One prize will be available for approximately every 10 participants
. If you wish to enter the draw, you will be asked to provide an email address at the end of the survey

bodyText:

Events / Activities
Water Sports Training Course (Sailing & Windsurfing) - CUHK Water Sports Centre 水上活動訓練課程 (風帆及滑浪風帆) - 中大水上活動中心 - Water Sports Centre / P E Unit
From: Kent Wong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
kentwong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
(The English version follows the Chinese one)
============ 中大水上活動中心通訊 =============
***** 訓練課程 *****
(更多資料: http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK)
初級滑浪風帆訓練班 (兩天課程) (適合初學人仕參與)
* 11月28 (六)及29 (日) (W10)
風帆入門訓練班 (第一級) (兩天課程)
* 12月5 (六)及12月6 (日) (S8)
風帆基本技巧訓練班 (第二級) (四天課程)
* 11月14日 (六) 及15日 (日) 及 11月21 (六) 及22 (日) – Class S7
# 為提供更完善的服務給您、中大不同部門及其他學會對水上活動的需要，本中心現特設 "度身訂造" 服務，馬上致電2603 6776聯絡我們!
***** 報名方式 *****
(更多資料: https://tinyurl.com/kxp3dwm2 or http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK)
網上報名日期：
Class S7 - 由2026年10月16日 (星期五) 下午5:30至10月23日 (星期五) 下午3:00，先到先得，額滿即止。
Class S8及W10 - 由2026年10月23日 (星期五) 下午5:30至10月27日 (星期二) 下午3:00，先到先得，額滿即止。
網上報名網址：
https://webapp.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/ras/restricted/eventlist?id=73
# 查詢請致電2603 6776 (水上活動中心辦事處)。
***** 人數上限 *****
(更多資料: http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK)
+ 滑浪風帆訓練班：上限5人
+ 風帆訓練班：上限6人
***** 收費 *****
(更多資料: http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK)
+ 滑浪風帆訓練班：
** 初級課程 - 學生$630，職員 (及家屬) $700
+ 風帆入門訓練班：
** 第一級 - 學生$680，職員 (及家屬) $740
+ 風帆基本技巧訓練班：
** 第二級 - 學生$1360，職員 (及家屬) $1480
體育部將津貼滑浪風帆及風帆訓練班($200)予全期出席之學生，退款將於課程後即時退回。
注意：
參加者須能穿著衣服及救生衣游泳50米。課程首日可能會安排游泳測試。
水上活動對體能有一定要求，參加者應確保身體狀況適合參與相關活動。
課程將以廣東話授課，並輔以英語說明。
報名一經確認後，恕不接受退款、更改課程或更換參加者（包括因疾病而未能出席的情況）。惟因惡劣天氣、報名人數不足或本中心取消課程而導致的情況除外。
如參與風帆基本技巧訓練班須持有中國香港帆船運動總會風帆入門（第一級）證書或中國香港帆船運動總會少年帆船第三級：舵手進階證書或康文署風帆入門訓練班100%出席證明或康文署少年帆船第三級：舵手進階資歷證明
報讀獨木舟二星證書課程或以上級別的參加者，必須於報名時出示相關資歷證明。未能提供有效證書者，本中心有權拒絕其報名申請。
參加者必須年滿14歲。18歲以下人士須取得家長、監護人或授權人士同意；16歲以下人士須由家長、監護人或授權人士陪同參與活動。陪同人士必須年滿 18歲。
課程費用僅包括教練費及器材使用費。成功完成課程並通過考核者，可申請相關證書。證書費用需另行支付：滑浪風帆$30及帆船$55 / $115
參加者須於課程當日自行前往水上活動中心集合。請自備泳衣、長袖上衣、適合下水使用且包趾包跟的運動鞋，以及午餐。
如報名人數不足，本中心保留取消課程的權利。受影響的參加者將獲個別電郵通知。
體育部將為出席率達 100% 的學生提供培訓津貼：獨木舟訓練($90)，滑浪風帆及帆船訓練($200)，津貼將於課程完成後發還。缺席或中途退出課程者將不獲發放津貼。
如有任何查詢，請聯絡：
水上活動中心
2603 6776
/ 體育部：3943 6097
******* News for the Water Sports Training Course *******
Basic Windsurfing Training Course (2-day course) (It also fit for Improver):
* 28-29 Nov (Sat & Sun) (W10)
Introduction to Sailing Training Course (Level 1) (2-day course)
* 5-6 Dec (Sat & Sun) (S8)
Sailing Basic Skills Training Course (Level 2) (4-day course)
* 14-15 Nov & 21-22 Nov (Sat & Sun) (S7)
- The Centre offers a tailored package for all CUHK members (services include a fun day, a certificate course, and a special event); for more information, please call 2603 6776 (CUWSC Office).
******* Enrollment *******
Online enrollment will be accepted on a first-come, first-served basis until the course reaches its maximum capacity.
Class S7 - 5:30 pm on 16 Oct to 3:00 pm on 23 Oct 2026
Class S8 & W10 - 5:30 pm on 23 Oct to 3:00 pm on 27 Oct 2026
Direct register link for user:
https://webapp.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/ras/restricted/eventlist?id=73
******* Max capacity *******
+ Windsurfing Training Course: Max. 5 persons
+ Sailing Training Course: Max. 6 persons
******* Course fee *******
+ Windsurfing Training Course:
- Student ($630), Staff & Family member ($700)
+ Introduction to Sailing Training Course (Level 1):
- Student ($680), Staff & Family member ($740)
+ Sailing Basic Skills Training Course (Level 2):
- Student ($1360), Staff & Family member ($1480)
Physical Education Unit will subsidize STUDENT with 100% attendance in Windsurfing and Sailing Training Course ($200). Subsidize will be refunded after the course except for abstention.
******** Contact us **********
Further information will be posted to Water Sports Centre Website (https://tinyurl.com/kxp3dwm2 or http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK), University Sports Centre notice board. We are welcome any inquiry kentwong@cuhk.edu.hk (email) & 2603 6776 (OFFICE)
Remarks:
Participants should be able to swim 50 metres while wearing clothing and a life jacket. A swimming assessment may be conducted on the first day of the course.
Please note that water sports require a reasonable level of physical fitness. Participants should ensure they are physically fit to join the activity.
The course will be conducted primarily in Cantonese with supplementary instruction in English where necessary.
No refunds, program changes or participant substitutions will be permitted after enrollment, including cases of illness. Exceptions will only be made in the event of adverse weather conditions, insufficient enrollment or course cancellation by the Centre
.
When participating Sailing Basic Skills Training Course, participants MUST holder of Sailing Federation of Hong Kong, China Introduction to Sailing (Level 1) Certificate or Holder of Sailing Federation of Hong Kong, China Junior Sail 3: Skipper Certificate or LCSD Introduction to Sailing Training Course 100% Attendance Record or LCSD Junior Sail 3: Skipper Competency Record.
Participants enrolling in the Kayak 2 Star Award course or above must present the relevant qualification certificate upon registration. Failure to provide valid certification may result in the Centre declining the enrollment.

Watoto 兒童合唱團音樂會
適逢善衡書院成立20周年，我們非常榮幸邀請到來自烏干達的 Watoto 兒童合唱團，與大家分享一個結合音樂、故事及文化交流的晚上。
一眾年輕表演者將透過歌唱、舞蹈及親身故事，與大家分享他們的經歷，以及對未來的盼望。以 「Better Days – There is Hope」 為主題，是晚除了合唱團演出及分享，亦設有攤位及互動活動，讓大家與表演者交流，感受不同文化。

^Recruiting vocally healthy participants aged 18 and above to participate in an acoustic analysis study to explore the quality and characteristics of the voice (HK$150 coupon) 誠意邀請18歲或以上沒有聲線障礙的人士參與探索聲線質量和特徵的聲學分析研究 (HK$150 coupon) - Department of Otorhinolarynogology, Head and Neck Surgery
From: Rina To
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
rinato@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學耳鼻咽喉 頭頸外科學系現正招募十八歲或以上沒有聲線障礙的人士參與一項聲學分析的研究，旨在探究平滑化倒頻譜突出峰值 (CPPS) 的臨界值和其診斷準確性。
CPPS是一種可應用於日常對話的聲線聲學分析參數。CPPS相對於其他常用的聲學參數具有更高的診斷準確性。但是，根據文獻的報告顯示，使用不同的語言，聲線樣本類型，和軟件，都會影響到CPPS的結果。我們希望這項研究的結果能夠為臨床醫生和研究人員對聲線障礙患者進行客觀測量並為聲線評估的量化結果提供明確的參考。
招募對象：
年滿十八歲或以上
沒有聲線問題的人士
以廣東話為母語
費用：全免
評估與檢查地點：威爾斯親王醫院
研究程序及内容：
1）參加者將填寫聲線問卷， 並親臨威爾斯親王醫院接受喉纖維內視鏡檢查和聲線錄製。

zikaiwang@link.cuhk.edu.hk
The Department of Otorhinolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, is currently recruiting vocally healthy participants aged 18 and above for a study investigating the cut-off score and diagnostic accuracy of the smoothed cepstral peak prominence (CPPS) for Cantonese speakers with dysphonia.
CPPS is a parameter for acoustic analysis of voice that can be used in everyday conversation to provide a more comprehensive and realistic picture of an individual's vocal characteristics in natural communication situations. CPPS has a higher diagnostic accuracy than other commonly used acoustic parameters. However, reports in the literature indicate that the use of different languages, different types of voice samples, and different software can affect the results of the CPPS. We hope that the results of this study will provide clinicians and researchers with a clear reference for the quantitative results of objective measurement and voice assessment in patients with voice disorders.
Recruitment target:
Age 18 or above
People who do not have voice problems
Fluent in Cantonese as a native language or proficient in Cantonese
Cost: Free of charge
Location: Prince of Wales Hospital
Procedures and details of this Study:
Participants will undergo a laryngeal videostroboscopy examination and a comprehensive voice assessment at Prince of Wales Hospital.
A videostroboscopy examination can clearly observe the throat to detect whether it has structural or functional problem for speaking. Each examination takes approximately thirty minutes. It is a low-risk procedure, and participants typically only experience mild discomfort.

研究目的：

【Recruitment: Pregnant Mothers for Prenatal Course Research
】

Up to HK$1,550 for completing all training and assessments

Purpose of the Study:
To investigate the short- and long-term effects of prenatal courses on maternal and child health.
Eligibility Criteria:
Local resident aged 18 or above
Currently pregnant with a singleton (30 weeks or less)
Chinese is the primary language spoken at home
Doing antenatal check-ups at Prince of Wales Hospital.
Study Details:
Participants will be randomly assigned to different prenatal courses
Training period: From mid to late pregnancy until the baby is born
Home-based training 5 days per week (each session lasts 5–40 minutes)
One pre-training assessment (HK$50 reward)
*Some participants may be invited for an MRI scan at Prince of Wales Hospital
Follow-up assessments from birth until the child is 2 years old (HK$300 reward per follow-up)
Each assessment includes: EEG, health questionnaires, infant behavior evaluation, home language sampling, and cognitive development testing (with reports)
Location for assessments and follow ups: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
We are currently offering full-time students an opportunity to join us for a research project supporting local students’mental health. You will take part in leading psychological assessments with students and parents. Logistical support may be needed occassionally.
Selection criteria:
Major in psychology or related disciplines
Highly motivated
Conscientious, organised, and good interpersonal skills
Proficiency in both written and spoken Chinese
Strong work ethic and a strong sense of responsibility to commit
Mature and articulate
Comfortable communicating with others especially with students and parents
Successful candidates will be under the supervision of Prof. Jennifer Tang from the Department of Educational Psychology.
Priority will be given to individuals who are pursuing a Psychology major/ minor and flexible with their schedule (preferably no less than 10-12 hours per week over 2-3 months).
How to apply?
If you are interested, please send your CV and transcript (Student version) to Justina Chay at justina.chay@cuhk.edu.hk.

Announcements
【$200 Coupon】Recruiting Children (aged under 33 months) for the Gut Microbiome and At-risk Children's Brain Development Study 誠意邀請33個月或以下兒童參加腸道微生態與兒童大腦發展及風險研究 - Department of Psychiatry
From: Dr. WONG Wing Ho, Oscar
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
hatch@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
家長您好，我們是香港中文大學醫學院精神科學系的研究團隊。本研究由香港中文大學醫學院精神科學系、內科及藥物治療學系統籌。
本研究團隊誠邀3歲以下兒童參與一項有關腸道微生態與兒童大腦發展及風險研究。此研究希望透過收集小朋友之大便及口腔樣本，幫助了解腸道微生態與大腦發展的關係。
研究對象:
1) 確診/懷疑小朋友有自閉症傾向或其他發展問題
2) 33個月或以下的小朋友 (交齊問卷和樣本的日子未滿3歲即可)
3) 父母皆為華裔或亞裔人士
以下為是次研究需要完成的事項：
1) 簽署參加同意書
2) 網上問卷調查：網上問卷主要詢問小朋友的行為及腸道情況，填寫時間約45分鐘
3) 收集大便和口腔樣本：我們會給家長一個樣本收集包，請家長使用收集包內的物在家中資協助收集樣本
4) 飲食習慣的問卷：記錄小朋友的飲食習慣
完成研究後，參加者可以獲得$200的超市現金券、 G-NiiB益生菌試用裝和腸道健康報告作為答謝 另外，家長有機會被邀請進行面談並隨訪2年,如有需要我們會提供轉介信。是次研究是自願參與性質參與，這個研究期間所取得的資料都會被嚴格保密。
如家長有意願參與此項研究，請填寫以下網上篩選問卷(https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_81kdBVoLu4f6l3o)。收到問卷回覆後，我們會再與合適參加是次研究的小朋友之家長連絡。
如果家長對研究細節有任何疑問，歡迎透過WhatsApp 6099-3064或致電 2607-6057與我們聯絡。
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dear Parents,
We are a team of researchers from the Department of Psychiatry at the Chinese University of Hong Kong. We are conducting a research project jointly organised by the Department of Psychiatry, the Department of Medicine and Therapeutics of the Chinese University of Hong Kong.
Our team sincerely invites your children to participate in research on the gut microbiome and children's brain development. Through collecting stool and buccal samples, we aim to investigate the relationship between the gut microbiome and brain development.
A gut health report will be provided, A G-Niib probiotics trial pack and a $200 supermarket voucher will be awarded to participants.
Target participants:
1) The child is diagnosed/suspected to have autism or other developmental problems
2) The child is under 33 months old (all questionnaires and samples are submitted before 3 years old)
3) Both parents are Chinese or Asian
Procedures and details of this Study:
1) Research Consent
2) Online Questionnaire : A 45-minute questionnaire on children’s behaviors and their physical health condition
3) Stool and Buccal Sample Collection: Samples collection kit will be provided for sample collection at home
4) Dietary Questionnaire: Recording children's eating habits
You will receive a $200 supermarket voucher after completing all the research procedures. Participation is voluntary, and your responses will be kept confidential. The information you provide will be used solely for research purposes.
If you are interested in participating in our research study, please fill out the following online questionnaire (https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_81kdBVoLu4f6l3o). We will contact you afterwards if your children are suitable to join this study.
For inquiries, please contact 2607-6057 or WhatsApp 6099-3064.

Public Lecture by Dr Winson Wong on "AI and FinTech: Global Governance and Asian Financial Hubs - From Stablecoins and Digital Banks to UN AI Initiatives and Public Engagement", 6 November (Fri), 11:00 am  - Lau Chor Tak Institute of Global Economics and Finance
From: Rachel Lee
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
igef@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Speaker:   Dr Winson Wong
Trainer of United Nations Institute of Training and Research
Date:         6 November 2026 (Friday)
Time:         11:00 am – 12:15 pm
Venue:       Lecture Theatre 5, 3/F, Cheng Yu Tung Building,
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Language: English
Abstract:
This lecture examines the evolving intersection of AI governance, FinTech development, and the strategic role of Asian financial hubs, with a particular focus on Hong Kong and Singapore. It highlights Hong Kong’s forward‑looking frameworks under HK FinTech 2030 and HK Banking 2030, alongside Singapore’s digital‑finance ecosystem and supervisory innovation. The session explores how stablecoins, digital banks, RegTech adoption and cross‑border supervisory models are reshaping financial development and governance across the region.
The presentation connects these developments with global regulatory trends informed by work with the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) on digital‑asset supervision, risk governance and financial‑innovation policy. It also draws on participation across United Nations AI governance platforms, including major UN conferences and multistakeholder initiatives focused on responsible AI, algorithmic accountability and governance mechanisms for high‑risk AI systems.
The session concludes by emphasising the importance of public engagement, governance literacy and inclusive participation in building trustworthy AI‑enabled financial ecosystems.
About the Speaker:
Dr. Winson Wong is a founding member of the UN Global-AI-Network and the Policy-Network-on-AI, contributing to UN governance-initiatives. He joined the inaugural Chief-AI-Officer cohort at Cornell University and has held fellowships in AI and FinTech across North-America, including post-doctoral-research. Holding a Doctor of FinTech from PolyU and advanced studies in International Law at UNITAR, he brings a global perspective to AI and financial-governance.
He also serves as a risk management executive in GBA banking and Lecturer at the HKIB, integrating supervisory innovation with professional-training. His policy-research includes BIS-linked projects with HKMA and MAS, covering digital assets and RegTech adoption.

Hello親愛嘅和聲同學仔～
有冇試過一日上完堂、做完一大堆嘢，返到和聲只係想唔做任何嘢
呢個 Semester，我哋兩個和聲 Final Year 學生想試下做一件唔太一樣嘅事：喺上莊以外，建立一個屬於和聲學生嘅
Soul Island Community
Soul Island
係
Professor Joseph Lau Scholarship for Innovative Initiative Project for
College Development
嘅其中一個得獎項目。
我哋想喺和聲整一個屬於大家嘅「小島」，俾你識下唔同科系嘅人、試下新嘢，或者純粹同一班人輕鬆咁玩下、傾下偈。
我哋希望呢度唔係另一個需要你投入大量 Commitment 嘅地方，而係一個可以俾你放鬆、識下唔同科系嘅朋友、試下新體驗，同一班人一齊好好過生活嘅小島
所以今個 10–11 月，我哋準備咗一系列
Wellness × Self-exploration × Social Connection
活動：
日期
主題
今次會玩咩？
23/10
Connection with My Body
日落 Yoga Wellness Dance × 和諧粉彩
25/10
Explore Myself
原創 LARP 劇本殺 × 自我探索 × 成長故事
30/10
Chill & Co-create
Chill Chat × Co-creation @ 榻榻米空間
7/11
Take It Outside
Group Outing｜神秘地點／活動出發！？
注意：活動會議廣東話進行。
每一節都可以獨立參加，唔需要有任何經驗，亦唔需要承諾參加晒全部活動。
可能 23/10 你會喺夕陽底下郁下個身體、畫下畫；

bodyText:

Free Prostate Health Screening ‼‼ 免費前列腺健康篩查－誠邀合資格男士參加 - S.H. Ho Urology Centre, Department of Surgery
From: Yellow Wong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
yellowwong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
根據衛生署數據，前列腺癌是本港男性常見的癌症之一。透過及早篩查，可以有效降低相關的健康風險。本次活動由中大何善衡泌尿中心舉辦，為合資格人士提供免費的前列腺特異抗原 (PSA) 檢測服務。
活動地點： 沙田區（詳細地址將於成功報名後通知）
活動內容：(所需時間約一小時)
1. 影片講解：深入淺出地介紹前列腺增生及前列腺癌的檢查與治療知識。
2. 前列腺篩查：合資格人士可獲免費前列腺特異抗原（PSA）測試乙次.
• 測試方式：我們將以指尖採血方式為參加者抽取血液樣本，並透過PSA檢測機進行現場測試，約十分鐘即可得知結果。
參加資格：
• 性別：男性
• 年齡：50-75歲
• 從未接受前列腺相關檢查
如有興趣參加活動，請填妥以下表格。
https://forms.office.com/r/HRJspBWSW6
如想了解更多關於前列腺癌風險的評估, 可瀏覽以下網址;
https://urologycentre.com.hk/zh-hant/diseases/detail/how-to-investigate-and-make-diagnosis-for-prostate-cance
r
參加者提供的所有資料將會被保密。如有任何查詢，請與我們聯絡 （Whatsapp: 5160 6904；電郵：yellowwong@cuhk.edu.hk）。
According to data from the Department of Health, prostate cancer is one of the most common cancers among men in Hong Kong. Early screening can effectively reduce related health risks. This event is organized by the S.H. Ho Urology Centre of CUHK, providing free Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) testing services for eligible individuals.
Event Venue: Shatin District (the exact address will be provided after successful registration)
Event Details: (Estimated duration: about one hour)
Video Presentation: An easy-to-understand introduction to the examination and treatment of prostate cancer and benign prostatic hyperplasia
Prostate Screening: Eligible participants will receive one free Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) test.
Testing Method: We will collect blood samples from participants via a fingertip blood test and conduct an on-site PSA test using a PSA testing device. Results will be available in about ten minutes.
Eligibility:
Gender: Male
Age: 50-75 years old
Have never undergone any prostate-related examination
If you are interested in participating, please fill in the online form below;
https://forms.office.com/r/HRJspBWSW6
For more information about the assessment of prostate cancer risk, please visit the following website:
https://urologycentre.com.hk/zh-hant/diseases/detail/how-to-investigate-and-make-diagnosis-for-prostate-cancer
All information provided by participants will be kept confidential. For any enquiries, please contact us (WhatsApp: 5160 6904; Email: yellowwong@cuhk.edu.hk)
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

除特殊情況外，禮堂開放予使用者進行籃球、羽毛球及匹克球等康體活動，使用者可按活動時間表訂明的時段自備體育器材到場使用，籃球時段毋須預約。活動時間表於每學期及暑期公佈，個別時段或會因考試及其他外借活動有所更改，恕不另行通知。
羽毛球及匹克球時段採用先到先得方式，不設預約，使用者必須於使用前於學生事務處服務台登記，請出示所有借用者之「中大通」以供查閱。每個羽毛球場或匹克球場可容納最多一組四人同時使用，若有違者，學生事務處職員有權停止借用者使用。每組借用者於每個羽毛球或匹克球時段內最多可借用一個時段（三十分鐘），如該借用時段結束後未有其他使用者輪候，可繼續使用直至有其他使用者輪侯使用為止。如遇場地已滿，請於服務台登記輪候表格。如使用者未能於輪候表格所顯示之時間十五分鐘內到場，該項輪候將告自動取消。
活動時間表及詳細場地使用守則，請參考學生事務處之網站：
活動時間表
https://www.osa.cuhk.edu.hk/wp-content/uploads/document/campus-life/amenities/pommerenke-student-centre/Activities-schedule-wef-20261001.pdf
場地使用守則
https://www.osa.cuhk.edu.hk/wp-content/uploads/document/campus-life/amenities/pommerenke-student-centre/OSA-Website-OSA_PSC_G01_2026-October.pdf
Pickleball Session introduced in Multi-purpose Hall (Room G01) of Pommerenke student Centre
Starting from October, Pickleball Session is introduced in Multi-purpose Hall (Room G01) of Pommerenke student Centre for use by CUHK students and staff.
The Multi-purpose Hall is available for recreational/sports activities such as basketball, badminton and pickleball, except for special occasions. No reservation is required for basketball sessions. No sports equipment would be offered, and users should bring their own sports equipment. The recreational/sports activity schedule is announced in Terms 1 and 2 and in the summer. The activity schedule is subject to change due to examinations and special events, etc. without prior notice.
Badminton and pickle ball courts operate on a “first-come, first-served” basis. No reservation is required. Users must register at the OSA Service Counter before use. Please provide the valid CU Link Cards of all users for identification. Each badminton or pickle ball court can be used by a group of no more than FOUR users. Staff of the OSA reserves the right to debar users from using the court for non-compliance with the stated regulation. Each group of users could only reserve a badminton or a pickle ball court for ONE session of 30 minutes during each badminton or pickle ball session. If there are no other users waiting for the court, the users may continue to use the court after the time slot ends. Then the court is full, the users may register in the waiting list at the OSA Service Counter. If a user fails to arrive within 15 minutes of the time shown on the waiting list, their place on the waiting list will be automatically cancelled.
Please visit the website of Office of Student Affairs for the activity schedule and the detailed user guidelines.
Activity Schedule
https://www.osa.cuhk.edu.hk/wp-content/uploads/document/campus-life/amenities/pommerenke-student-centre/Activities-schedule-wef-20261001.pdf

  [Online experiment] Looking for native English speakers
Prof. Haerim Hwang (Department of English, CUHK) is looking for participants for a study on language production.
Which participants are we looking for?
- English is your first/native and dominant language
- Your graduate degree is not in the field of linguistics
- Can use your laptop/computer and have access to stable internet (no smartphones, laptops, or hotspot)
- Can participate in an experiment on Zoom in a quiet environment
- Have Chrome on your laptop/computer
How do I participate?
1. Fill out this questionnaire
-- English speakers: https://forms.gle/ttuhGGCwRx2n95kBA
2. Our research team will reach out to you, confirming your availability.
3. It will take approximately 2 hours to complete these tasks.
What do I get out of the study?
You will get HK$250 in cash upon the completion of the task.
Your participation will enhance our understanding of how people process English sentences.
Questions?
Contact Prof. Haerim Hwang at haerimhwang@cuhk.edu.hk
Ethics Approval
The Chinese University of Hong Kong Survey and Behavioural Research Ethics Committee SBREC (fssc02@cuhk.edu.hk) has vetted the study (Approval ID: SBRE-22-0026D). If you have any concerns regarding ethics, please contact them.

【Introduction】: This research study, titled “Compensation of White Matter Pathways and Networks in Chinese Children with Developmental Dyslexia in Hong Kong,” is led by Prof. Jingjing Zhao from the Department of Psychology at The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
【Description of the study】: The purpose of this study is to explore how white matter pathways in the brain may compensate for reading difficulties in Chinese-speaking children with developmental dyslexia in Hong Kong.
【Study Procedures】 ● Reading and Cognitive Assessments: Your child will participate in reading and cognitive assessments lasting approximately 30–40 minutes. You are not required to complete any of these tasks. ● Brain Imaging (MRI Scan): Your child will also undergo a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan lasting about 20 minutes. The MRI procedure is non-invasive, painless, radiation-free, and no sedation. Please inform the research team in advance if your child has claustrophobia, metal implants, or a pacemaker.
Target participants: Children aged 8–16 years, whose parents are native Mandarin or Cantonese speakers, are eligible to participate.
【Data Confidentiality and Usage】:All data will be handled in accordance with data protection and privacy regulations. All collected data will be anonymized and will not include identifiable information (e.g., name, ID number, contact details). Data will be used solely for academic research purposes.
針對多種神經發育學習障礙的閱讀困難跨診斷研究
現正招募：
8-16歲、廣東話為母語的兒童
（1） 正常發展或
（2）被診斷或懷疑有任何一項：
（i）自閉症
（ii）注意力缺陷
（iii）讀寫障礙
測試内容：
語言、記憶及認知能力測試
磁力共振掃描（MRI）
時間：2小时
地點：威爾士親王醫院（第一城）
合資格參與者完成所有測試後可獲得:
綜合語言能力評核報告
最高達$200 現金
兒童磁力共振影相電子版
神經指標分析報告

Announcements
Better Gut, Better Sleep? Gut-Brain Study | Earn up to HKD 500  「腸」通無阻，瞓得更好？「腸·腦」研究 | 最高可獲 HKD 500 - Department of Psychiatry
From: Michael Ng
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
tsztsunng@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
近年醫學界發現，我們的腸道健康與大腦息息相關！原來「便秘」和「睡眠質素」的改變，可能是腦部退化的早期信號。為了深入了解這條神奇的「腸腦連線」，香港中文大學精神科學系睡眠研究組現正招募研究參加者。
研究對象:
年齡介乎 50 至 80 歲
關注腸道健康或者受便秘問題困擾（如排便困難、次數較少等）
沒有腦退化、精神疾病史
參加者需完成以下簡單程序：
填寫問卷 及 進行簡單面談
進行一次非入侵性睡眠檢測
記錄連續兩星期「大便日記」
進行一次結腸運輸試驗
收集一次大便樣本

[網址連結:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_eeTcY6hrKILNwhg
]
如對研究內容有任何疑問，歡迎致電 3919 7792 / 9568 9006 或 WhatsApp 9568 9006與負責研究人員聯絡、查詢詳情。謝謝

Recent research suggests that gut health is closely linked to brain function. Changes in bowel habits (e.g. constipation) and sleep quality may even be early signs of neurodegeneration.
To better understand this “gut–brain axis, we sincerely invite you to take part in our research study.
Who can join:
Aged 50–80
Concerned about gut health or bothered by constipation
No history of dementia or psychiatric disorders
What you will do:
Complete questionnaires and a brief interview
Undergo a sleep assessment
Record a 2-week bowel diary
Complete a colonic transit time test
Collect one stool sample
Incentive:
All assessments are free of charge.
Eligible participants may receive up to HKD 500 in supermarket vouchers upon completion.
Interested? Please sign up here:
[
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_eeTcY6hrKILNwhg
]

3919 7792 / 9568 9006
WhatsApp 9568 9006

From: New Asia College

(Please scroll down for
the English version)
第十七屆余英時先生歷史講座
歡迎同學、校友、教職員及公眾參加
為促進學術文化交流及推動歷史研究，「余英時先生歷史講座」自二OO七年起創立，每年邀請一位對歷史研究具傑出成就的學者蒞臨發表演講。本屆講座將於十一月舉行，由
中研院近代史研究所特聘研究員康豹教授（
Professor Paul R. Katz
）
主講下列兩場講座：
第一講
中國法律文化中的神判與司法連續體
主持：香港中文大學歷史系副教授卜永堅教授
日期：二O二六年十一月六日（星期五）
時間：下午四時正
語言：英語
地點：香港中文大學大學行政樓地下祖堯堂
第二講
瘟疫、罪惡與天譴：華人社會中的受難儀式
主持：香港中文大學歷史系副教授賀喜教授
日期：二O二六年十一月八日（星期日）
時間：下午三時正
語言：普通話
地點：香港歷史博物館地下演講廳
座位：一百三十九個，先到先得，滿座即止。演講廳將於講座開始前十五分鐘開放。
歡迎現場或網上參與。
有興趣的參加者請於二O二六年十月三十日或之前填妥網上報名表格：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13735740
如有查詢，請聯絡新亞書院院務室許女士（電話：3943-3739；電郵：
fredahui@cuhk.edu.hk
）。
Yu Ying-shih Lecture in History 202
6
/2
7
ALL are welcome
To enhance cultural exchange and academic research, the “Yu Ying-shih Lecture in History” has been organised since 2007. This year, we are honoured to have invited
Professor
Paul R. Katz
,
Distinguished Research Fellow of the Institute of Modern History, Academia Sinica
, to deliver the following two lectures in November:
1st Lecture
Divine Justice and the Judicial Continuum in Chinese Legal Culture
Moderator: Professor Puk Wing-kin, Associate Professor, Department of History, CUHK
Date: 6 November 2026 (Friday)
Time: 4:00 p.m.
Language: English
Venue: Cho Yiu Conference Hall, G/F, University Administration Building, CUHK
2nd Lecture
Plagues, Sin and Divine Punishment: Rites of Affliction in Chinese Society
Moderator: Professor He Xi, Associate Professor, Department of History, CUHK
Date: 8 November 2026 (Sunday)
Time: 3:00 p.m.
Language: Mandarin
Venue: Lecture Hall, G/F, Hong Kong Museum of History
Seats: 139 seats, allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Audience will be admitted 15 minutes before the lecture starts.
Participation in person or online via Zoom is welcome.
Please complete the online registration form at
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13735740
on or before 30 October 2026.
For enquiries, please contact Ms. Freda Hui (Tel: 3943-3739; Email:
fredahui@cuhk.edu.hk
), College Office, New Asia College.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

Announcements
【Online Lecture】The Characteristics of "Humanistic" Application in Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Lyric Creations 星雲大師歌詞創作的「人間」應用特質 星雲大師歌詞創作的「人間」應用特質 - Centre for the Study of Humanistic Buddhism
From: 人間佛教研究中心 Centre for the Study of Humanistic Buddhism
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
cshb@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【精彩上線｜紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰系列講座】
為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
星雲大師歌詞創作的「人間」應用特質
時間：11月19日 | 週四 14:30 - 16:30
講者：林仁昱教授 | 中興大學中文系特聘教授兼藝術中心主任
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：ZOOM網絡會議
ZOOM ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741303
演講簡介：
星雲大師在倡議與實踐「人間佛教」的道路上，不僅以歌曲來推廣理念，許多歌曲也成為導引新時代儀節與活動的重要部分。從1950年代作〈西方〉以取代念佛共修的傳統迴向四句偈，作〈佛化婚禮祝歌〉來適應建立「佛化家庭」的重要典儀；1970年代作〈三寶頌〉濃縮歷代各種〈三皈依〉偈讚歌詞要義，更方便傳唱應用；到2000年以後，創作眾多「人間音緣」歌詞，廣徵作曲，使相同歌詞可有不同風格的譜曲，靈活運用於各種弘法與社會活動，充分表現「人間」應用的特質。本次講座將順著時代脈絡，剖析歌詞內涵與實際應用情形，論述其具體意義及影響力。
On his path of advocating and practicing "Humanistic Buddhism," Venerable Master Hsing Yun not only promoted Buddhist concepts through songs, but many of his musical works also became essential components guiding rituals and activities in the modern era.
Historically, this practical approach unfolded across several key stages: In the 1950s, he composed Western Land (〈西方〉) to replace the traditional four-line verse for the dedication of merit during collective chanting cultivation, and penned the Blessing Song for Buddhist Weddings (〈佛化婚禮祝歌〉) to accommodate the pivotal rituals of establishing "Buddhist Families." 為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
太虛大師的世界佛教運動與文明論述：1920年代為中心
時間：10月27日 | 週二 14:30 - 16:30
講者：龔雋教授 | 中山大學哲學系教授
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任

報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741299
演講簡介：
本次講座立足於思想史的視野與方法，對太虛在1920年代的世界佛教運動及其文明論述進行詳密的討論與分析。分別從三個方面來開展論述。首先，把太虛的東西文明論放置在1920年代中國思想界有關東西文明與文化論爭這一脈絡中來加以審查，以深入理解太虛相關論述的思想史處境。其次，討論太虛歐美布教中的文明論論述，特別闡釋他是如何「格義」佛教與西方的科學、哲學而另立新說。最後，對太虛佛教世界化的文明論述進行評論，闡析其論述背後複雜的思想面向，特別是他的文明論述中所隱含的東方主義及其民族主義觀念。
Grounded in the perspectives and methodologies of intellectual history, this lecture provides a detailed discussion and analysis of Master Taixu’s World Buddhist Movement and his discourse on civilization during the 1920s.
The presentation unfolds across three primary dimensions:First, it situates Master Taixu’s views on Eastern and Western civilizations within the context of the 1920s Chinese intellectual debates surrounding Eastern versus Western civilization and culture, thereby deepening our understanding of the intellectual milieu of his discourse.
Second, it examines Master Taixu’s civilizational discourse during his missionary travels in Europe and America, specifically elucidating how he utilized Geyi (conceptual matching) to interface Buddhism with Western science and philosophy to forge his innovative theories.
Finally, the lecture reflects critically on Master Taixu’s civilizational discourse regarding the globalization of Buddhism, analyzing the complex intellectual dimensions underlying his arguments—particularly the implicit notions of Orientalism and nationalism embedded within his discourse on civilization.
嘉賓簡介：
龔雋教授，現任中山大學哲學系教授、中華外國哲學史學會東方哲學專業委員會副主任、中國社科院評價研究院宗教專業委員會委員，並擔任《新史學》、《漢語佛學評論》、《人文宗教研究》等多種學術刊物編委。主要從事中國佛教思想的教學與研究，代表性著作包括《作為「知識」的近代佛學史論——在東亞視域內的知識史論述》（商務印書館，2019，合著）、《中國禪學研究入門》（復旦大學出版社，2009，合著）及《禪史鉤沉：以問題為中心的思想史論述》（北京三聯書店，2006）。另於海內外學術刊物發表論文四十餘篇。

唐忠毛教授，哲學博士、歷史學博士後。現任華東師範大學社會發展學院教授、博士生導師，華東師範大學區域文化資源與應用研究中心主任、華東師範大學宗教與社會研究中心副主任。兼任中國宗教學會理事、上海市宗教學會副會長。研究領域集中於佛教學、信仰民俗學、區域文化學等。出版專著多本發表論文多篇，代表論著有《佛教本覺思想論爭的現代性考察》（2006）《中國佛教近代轉型的社會之維——民間上海居士佛教篇組織與慈善研究》（2013）《從空性到體用——中國佛教心性本體論的建構與反思》（2019）等。主持國家社科基金重點、一般等項目多項，參與重大專案多項。近年來完成的國家社科基金項目成果包括《佛教中國化的民間民俗向度研究》《江南“廟-鎮”信仰空間與地方社會研究》等。

Dear All,
What will happen when Social Science meets Computer Science? Can social scientists benefit from computer science research?
You’re cordially invited to join the webinar of the
Computational Social Science Laboratory (CSSL@CUHK)
,
“A Generalized Conway–Maxwell–Poisson Model for Handling Inflation, Truncation, and Dispersion”
with the details below:
Date:
6 November 2026 (Friday)
Time:
09:30 - 11:00 (UTC+8, Hong Kong Time)
Speaker:
Prof. Tianji CAI (Professor, Department of Sociology, University of Macau)
Format:
Webinar (Links:
https://linktr.ee/cssl.cuhk
)
For further details, please refer to the
poster
.
It would be greatly appreciated if you could join us and share the information with your colleagues, friends, and students as appropriate.
For enquiries, please contact us at
csspfs@cuhk.edu.hk
. Thank you.
About CSSL@CUHK
Large amounts of data are now being produced, collected, and analysed at unprecedented speed, breadth, depth, and scale. Focusing on the development and application of computational methods for complex and large-scale human behavior and behavioral change, Computational Social Science addresses fundamental questions about individuals and collectives, and major social problems. With the aim to promote interdisciplinary collaborations in addressing substantive social science questions, the
CSSL@CUHK
was formed in April 2021.

Contemplative Workshop Series | Free of charge 靜觀工作坊系列 | 費用全免 - Department of Educational Administration and Policy
From: Ng Tsz Ying

1155258073@link.cuhk.edu.hk

靜觀工作坊系列
對象：歡迎所有職員及學生（職員及學生名額各設上限）
主要語言：廣東話
地點：何添樓G6室

費用全免
芳香療法工作坊
導師： 吳嘉麗博士
透過靜觀嗅聞與觀察，探索精油的舒緩力量。本工作坊將帶您運用感官，認識芳香療法的基礎知識，並體驗香氣如何促進放鬆與身心健康。
日期及時間：2026年11月13日（星期五）12：30–14：00
名額：15位

建議穿著輕便服裝

請自備潔手工具
探索內在之旅：明陣靜觀步行工作坊
導師：張曉藍女士
在明陣步道上緩緩行走，讓身心回歸當下。本工作坊邀請您靜下心來，專注於每一步，向內反思。無需任何經驗，只需帶著開放的心前來。
日期及時間：2026年11月20日（星期五）14：00–15：30
名額：15位
活動安排： 將先於室內進行簡短講解，然後移師戶外進行靜觀步行。

建議穿著輕便服裝

請自備飲用水
園藝治療工作坊
導師：劉雅詩博士
通過插乾花與大自然連結。本工作坊將帶您靜心創作屬於自己的乾花作品，體驗植物帶來的療癒與平靜。完成後可將作品帶回家，延續這份靜觀體驗。
日期及時間：2026年11月19日（星期四）12：30–14：00
名額：15位

建議穿著輕便服裝
本活動由香港中文大學教學發展及語言培訓基金 (TDLEG) 贊助
如有查詢，請聯絡李小姐（
chingtungli@cuhk.edu.hk
）

Language: Cantonese
Venue: Ho Tim Building, Room G6

Free of charge
Aromatherapy Workshop
Instructor: Dr. NG Ka Lai, Emily
Explore the calming power of essential oils through mindful smelling and observation. In this hands-on workshop, you will engage your senses, learn about aromatherapy basics, and experience how scents can support ax.
Date & Time: 13 November 2026 (Friday), 12:30 – 14:00
Quota: 15 participants

Suggested to wear casual/comfortable clothing

Please bring personal hand-sanitizing materials
Journey Within: A Labyrinth and Mindful Walking Workshop
Instructor: Ms. Cheung Hiu Nam
Take a slow, mindful walk along the labyrinth path. This workshop invites you to quiet your mind, focus on your steps, and reflect inwardly. No prior experience is needed, just come with an open heart.
Date & Time: 20 November 2026 (Friday), 14:00 – 15:30
Quota: 15 participants
Activity Arrangement: The workshop will begin with a short indoor briefing, followed by the mindfulness walking practice outdoors

Suggested to wear casual/comfortable clothing

Please bring your own drinking water
Horticultural Therapy Workshop
Instructor:  Dr. LAU Ngar Sze
Connect with nature through the art of dried flower arrangement. In this workshop, you will mindfully create your own dried flower piece while experiencing the calming and therapeutic benefits of working with plants. Take your handmade creation home as a reminder of your practice.
Date & Time: 19 November 2026 (Thursday), 12:30 – 14:00
Quota: 15 participants

Suggested to wear casual/comfortable clothing
This activity is sponsored by the Teaching Development and Language Enhancement Grant (TDLEG) of The Chinese University of Hong Kong.

)

Announcements
We need you!! AI+Music!! Recruiting Young Music Lovers | AI and Popular Song Emotion Categorization Research 一齊聽歌! 招募音樂愛好青年｜人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究 - Department of Psychiatry
From: Xiuyang Meng
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
招募音樂愛好青年｜人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究
我們正在尋找熱愛音樂的你，參與人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究，用你的聽感為 AI 模型注入真實的青年情緒視角。
研究目的
本研究旨在運用人工智能技術，從青年視角對粵語流行歌曲進行情緒分類標註，評估青年群體對音樂情緒的主觀感知特徵，並為個性化音樂推薦系統及情緒調節相關研究提供數據支持。
招募條件
8 至 24 歲，熱愛音樂且經常聆聽流行音樂，能流暢使用粵語及英語進行溝通與表達的青年。
參與內容
聆聽 50 首粵語流行歌曲，並完整聽畢每首參與標註的曲目，依據自身主觀體驗與即時情緒感受，將歌曲進行情緒分類。
如何加入？
請點擊以下連結進行註冊，並回答幾條簡單問題。研究員將聯絡適合的參加者，詳細解釋研究內容：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_5pU67FrIxYilalw
聯絡我們
如有任何疑問，請於辦公時間內致電 6115-0322 與研究助理陳小姐 或 蒙先生聯絡。
Recruiting Young Music Lovers | AI and Popular Song Emotion Categorization Research
We are looking for music lovers like you to participate in our research on AI and popular song emotion categorization, contributing your listening experience to inject authentic youth emotional perspectives into our AI model.
Purpose of the Study
This study aims to use artificial intelligence technology to annotate the emotion categories of Cantopop songs from a youth perspective, evaluate the subjective emotional perception characteristics of young people towards music, and provide data support for personalized music recommendation systems and emotion regulation-related research.
Eligibility Criteria
Young people aged 18 to 24 who love music, listen to popular music regularly, and are able to communicate fluently in Cantonese and English.
Participation Content
Listen to 50 Cantopop songs in full and categorize each song according to your subjective experience and immediate emotional feelings.
How to Join?
Please click the link below to register and answer a few simple questions. Our researchers will contact eligible participants to explain the study details in full:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_5pU67FrIxYilalw
Contact Us
If you have any questions, please call 6115-0322 during office hours to speak with our research assistants Ms. Chan or Mr. Meng.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

/weekly/

Announcements
Invite individuals aged 12-19 to participate in research on light therapy for depression (earn 1400 HKD)  抑鬱症的光治療研究招募12-19歲參加者 (最高可獲1400元) - Department of Psychiatry
From: Xingle Gao
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
xinglegao@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
你是否正在受抑鬱情緒困擾，且好似「夜貓」習慣好夜瞓，情緒精力好低？
本研究為一項隨機對照試驗，評估在「夜晚型」抑鬱症青少年中，光治療作為輔助性治療改善情緒和睡眠的效果。
參加者將進行為期 8 週的光治療，期間將有精神科醫生及研究團隊全程跟進，提供專業評估及指導。
參加可獲：
費用全免：所有治療及評估免費。
交通津貼：完成全部研究評估，最高可獲 HKD$1400。
合資格人士需：
年齡 12 至 19 歲
正受抑鬱情緒困擾
習慣成日好夜瞓
如何報名：
請即掃描海報上 QR Code，或點擊下面連結，用 1-3 分鐘填寫簡單問卷作初步篩查。
若合適，研究團隊成員會主動聯絡你，詳細解釋研究。
If you are interested in participating in this study, please complete the survey below. It will take approximately 1–3 minutes. Eligible participants will be contacted for further information.

https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_8BbkFUn0tn570JE
查詢詳情：
請WhatsApp 或致電研究團隊：92916602
辦公時間：星期一至五 10:00-18:00，公眾假期除外

Announcements
【Overweight or obesity, lifestyle intervention research】 Recruiting individuals with central obeisty aged 40-64 in the study  【改善中央肥胖，生活方式干預研究】中央肥胖改善計劃誠邀40-64歲合資格人士參與 - Department of Sports Science and Physical Education; Program Director: Prof. Eric Tsz-chun POON
From: HE Ye
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
heye@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學體育運動科學系誠邀中央肥胖人士參與健康管理研究！
研究目的：
中央肥胖與血糖異常、心血管疾病及其他代謝健康問題的風險增加有關。為應對這一公共健康挑戰，香港中文大學體育運動科學系正開展健康生活方式計劃，提供個人化健康支援。
參加條件：
年齡：40-64歲
平時少做運動/無規律運動習慣
中央肥胖：男性腰圍 ≥ 90 cm; 女性腰圍 ≥ 80 cm
過去三個月體重變動≤5%
現時沒有服用長期藥物
參加方法：
掃描海報二維碼或通過鏈接作網上登記【
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_2bLgS3k7oUW0TMa
】
研究團隊會進行初步篩選，以了解您是否符合基本參加資格
成功通過初步篩選後，預約檢查時間
前往香港中文大學汾陽體育館參加檢查
如果符合參加條件，將會被隨機分組，正式開展後續正式的健康生活方式計劃
參與地點：
香港中文大學汾陽體育館G02室
如您有任何疑問，可通過以下渠道聯絡這項研究的相關人員：
何小姐
WhatsApp: 94463265
電郵: heye@link.cuhk.edu.hk
[
數據安全聲明
]
所有檢測結果加密儲存，僅供研究團隊匿名分析，您可隨時要求刪除個人資料
[
歡迎邀請身邊感興趣的親友參加
]
Study Purpose:
Central obesity is associated with an increased risk of abnormal glucose regulation, cardiovascular disease, and other metabolic health problems. To help address this growing public health concern, the Department of Sports Science and Physical Education at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is launching a Healthy Lifestyle Program that offers personalized health support for individuals with central obesity.
Recruitment criteria:
Aged between 40 and 64 years
No regular exercise habits
Central obesity: waist circumference ≥ 90 cm for men and ≥ 80 cm for women
Body weight fluctuation ≤5% in the past three months
Not taking any chronic medication
Study arrangement:
Scan the QR code to register (
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_2bLgS3k7oUW0TMa
)
The study team will select participants based on the registration information
Arrange a screening time
Arrive at CUHK Kwok Sports Building for the test
If you are eligible, you will be randomly assigned to start the formal Healthy Lifestyle Intervention Program
Study Location:
Room G02, Kwok Sports Building, Department of Sports Science and Physical Education, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shatin
Contact Us
If you are interested and have any inquiries, please feel free to contact us:
Ms. He
WhatsApp: 94463265
Email: heye@link.cuhk.edu.hk
[Data safety] All data obtained during the study will be kept strictly confidential
.
[Welcome to invite friends and family who are interested in participating in our study]

From: Hong Kong Institute of Asia-Pacific Studies

(The application below is conducted in Chinese only.)
日期：2026年10月28日（星期三）
時間：下午12時半至2時
地點：香港中文大學利黃瑤璧樓5樓505室
語言：廣東話
講者：黃可兒小姐
免費登記：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741697
講者簡介：
黃可兒小姐，香港中文大學歷史系畢業，日本語言及教育碩士。研習多年日本歷史，近年專注十九世紀中葉至戰前香港與日本的民間交流，關注日本遊客以至居港日裔群體的跨域活動。研究會同時閱讀兩地歷史資料作對照，並結合親身走訪實地，梳理港日民間層面的流動與社群互動，呈現近代東亞區域的歷史面貌。
講座簡介：
本講座聚焦戰前抵港日籍基層女性「唐行婦」群體，以本港舊地圖、跑馬地墳場墓碑、兩地文獻史料，還原她們在香港的聚居形態、產業活動與本地社群互動。探析香港因航運、煤炭貿易成為東亞唐行婦核心集散地的緣由，結合保良局歷史文物對照近代女性處境，重構香港近代跨境移民與基層社會的真實面貌。

Events / Activities
午間花藝靜觀給自己花時間：找回心花怒放的我 Midday Floral Mindfulness Give Yourself "Flower Time": Rediscover Your Inner Blooming Self   - ILC
From: ILC
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ilc-counsel@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

給自己花時間：找回心花怒放的我

花一個下午，默默穿透話語，引用花的形態及靜觀小練習，直接感受美好，學會善待自己，重遇內心明媚時光。
工作坊詳情
日期： 2026年10月29日（星期四）
⏰ 時間： 下午 12:30 – 2:30
地點： 大學圖書館地庫進學園進台階
語言： 粵語
# 每位報名者將獲贈兩枝鮮花，用於正念冥想練習。
導師簡介
楊幗慧 Ada Yeung
-             花藝師、花療靜觀創立人及園藝治療分享者。
-             香港80年老字號花店（Anglo Chinese Florist）第三代傳人。
-             自幼研習繪畫與手藝，及逾十年的禪修冥想經歷，有感鮮花亦是是修心靜觀、令人快樂及美學兼備的手藝。
-             希望推動更多人透過禪修、花藝及大自然美學探索自我和找回內在平靜，為社會帶來更多減壓和諧空間。
報名詳情：
https://webapp.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/ras/restricted/event?id=116945

Taking the Time to Unwind and Reconnect with Your Inner Self through Flowers

Through the different senses of flowers and gentle mindfulness practices, let’s experience beauty, learn to treat ourselves kindly, and enjoy a moment of peace together.
Workshop Details
Date: 29 October 2026 (Thu)
⏰ Time: 12:30 pm – 2:30 pm
Venue: The Forum, Learning Garden, LG/F, University Library
Language: Cantonese
# Each registrant will be given two stalks of flowers for mindfulness practices.
About the Speaker
Ada Yeung
Florist, Horticultural Therapy Practitioner, and Founder of Floral Mindfulness.
Third-generation successor of Anglo Chinese Florist, an 80-year legacy florist in Hong Kong.
With a background in painting and handicrafts since childhood and over a decade of meditation practice, Ada deeply believes that floral art brings about aesthetic beauty and inner peace.

bodyText:

Announcements
【Earn HK$500 coupon】 Recruiting adults (aged 18-65) to participate in research on online therapy for insomnia 【可獲得 500元現金券】招募成年人 (18-65歲)參與失眠的數碼化治療研究 - Psychiatry
From: Charis
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
你是否經常在床上輾轉難眠，夜醒或早醒？你並不孤單——許多人都面臨著同樣的問題。我們誠邀您參與研究，讓專業數碼化治療助你改善睡眠！
研究目的
本研究旨在評估市民對數碼化失眠認知行為治療聊天機器人的遵從性，以及其對改善睡眠問題的效果。
治療方式
· 由專業臨床心理學家及精神科醫生設計的電子化治療
· 完全免費
參與資格
· 18至65歲能說廣東話流利溝通（能流利閱讀並理解廣東話）的香港居民
· 在過去一個月內，每週至少三晚出現睡眠困擾
· 最近四周或以上無需長期服藥
參與研究，獲得獎勵！
完成所有治療及後續測試後，您可獲得高達500港幣。
如何加入？
請點擊以下連結進行註冊，並回答幾條簡單問題。研究員將聯絡適合的參加者，詳細解釋研究內容：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4UPFh054GtJGXX0
聯絡我們
如有任何疑問，請於辦公時間內致電 6115-0322 與研究助理聯絡。
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Do you often toss and turn in bed, wake up frequently at night, or wake up too early? You are not alone—many people experience the same challenges. We invite you to participate in our study and explore professional digital treatment to improve your sleep!
Purpose of the Study
This research aims to evaluate the public’s adherence to a digital insomnia cognitive behavioural therapy chatbot and assess its effectiveness in improving sleep problems.
Treatment Method
· A professionally designed digital therapy created by clinical psychologists and psychiatrists
· Completely free of charge
Eligibility Criteria
· Hong Kong residents aged 18 to 65 who can speak in Cantonese fluently, read and understand Cantonese
· Experienced sleep disturbances at least 3 nights per week in the past month
· No need for long-term medication for the past four weeks or more.
Receive Rewards for Participating!
Upon completion of all treatment sessions and follow-up assessments, participants will receive up to HKD 500.
How to Join?
Click the link below to register and answer a few simple questions. Our researchers will contact suitable participants to provide further details:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4UPFh054GtJGXX0
Contact Us
If you have any questions, please call 6115-0322 during office hours to speak with our research assistants.
View Count

For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

Lecture Demonstration: Cantonese Contemporary Music

29 October 2026 (Thursday), 8:00 pm

Lee Hysan Concert Hall, The Chinese University of Hong Kong

Free admission with registration
Sign up:
https://forms.gle/iitUp9BKi3o6CaR69
The world-renowned
Mivos Quartet
will present works by faculty, students, and recent graduates of the CUHK Department of Music, written in response to the research theme
“Writing Contemporary Music in Cantonese: Practices and Potentialities”
. Each piece explores a range of approaches to composing with Cantonese text — from deriving pitched materials from tonal contours or psychoacoustic analyses of the language, to shaping musical structure through the narrative and poetic qualities of a text.
Before the performance, Prof. Kai-Young Chan will introduce(in Cantonese) the research project and the works featured in the demonstration, followed by a panel discussion (in English) in which the composers and the Mivos Quartet reflect together on contemporary music in Cantonese.

演繹香港中文大學音樂系師生及近期畢業生的作品，回應研究主題「粵語當代音樂創作：實踐與潛能」。各作品探索以粵語文本為素材進行創作的多種可能，例如從聲調輪廓或心理聲學分析啟發旋律寫作、以文本的敘事或詩意特質塑造音樂結構等。

bodyText:

Announcements
Free HPV Screening for Men in Specific Groups [Free!!!] !!!注意: 男性特定群組 HPV 病毒篩查   [費用全免] [$400交通津貼] - Department of Surgery
From: Tim Lau
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
timlau@surgery.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學泌尿外科研究招募
:
香港中文大學泌尿外科現正進行一項男性特定群體的尿液及生物樣本HPV和病例對照研究。人類乳頭瘤病毒（HPV） 是全球最常見的性傳染病毒之一，能影響男性並導致多種疾病，包括生殖器疣（椰菜花）、陰莖癌、肛門癌 及 口咽癌。然而，男性 HPV 的感染情況一直缺乏研究，而你的參與將有助填補這個重要的知識空白。
本研究旨在了解HPV感染率、患者人口統計特徵、臨床特徵以及被診斷患有HPV相關惡性腫瘤的男性患者的疾病負擔。以評估男性尿液 HPV 測試的準確性，並更深入了解男性感染 HPV的風險因素，以及幫助未來預防及治療策略。
-如初步檢測確診為HPV陽性的患者，或將安排進一步行檢查 (例如:軟式膀胱鏡檢查等等)及跟進複檢。
參加者條件（男性，18歲或以上）：
1) 陰莖癌，肛⾨癌，或咽喉癌患者
2) 曾患性傳染病
3) 曾有同性性⾏為
(參加者太多, 其他組別優先)
4) 慢性前列腺炎患者
地點：沙⽥威爾斯親王醫院
樣本收集： 尿液及尿道拭子、口咽拭子、肛門拭子、冠狀溝拭子
-填寫簡單問卷
-根據情況也可能採集 20 毫升血液
[費用全免]
-完成整個研究計劃後可獲得港幣
$400
津貼
參加者的資料將會以專業方式絕對保密!!
所收集的資料僅用於學術研究用途
名額有限，先到先得!
閣下如對本研究有興趣請透過以下連結報名：
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf__iQ0Ike8hpG6qIm1mjtF0nCTdcPFKT2v9jFARsuZbqjMJw/viewform?usp=header
-如果評估合適參與研究，將稍後聯絡你，謝謝
如有查詢，歡迎電郵: timlau@surgery.cuhk.edu.hk，與研究人員劉先生聯絡。
________________________________________________________________________
Free HPV Screening for Men in Specific Groups [Free!!]
The Chinese University of Hong Kong Division of Urology Research Recruitment
The Department of Surgery (Urology), The Chinese University of Hong Kong is currently recruiting participants for a hybrid cohort and case-control study on male urinary HPV.
Human Papillomavirus (HPV) is one of the most common sexually transmitted viruses worldwide. It can affect men and lead to serious conditions including genital warts, penile cancer, anal cancer, and oropharyngeal cancer. However, HPV infection in men remains under-studied. Your cooperation is highly solicited.
This research aims to determine HPV prevalence, patient demographics, clinical characteristics, and disease burden in men. It will also evaluate the accuracy of a new urine-based HPV DNA test and explore risk factors to support future prevention and treatment strategies.
Participants who test positive for HPV in the initial urine test may be invited for further investigations (e.g. flexible cystoscopy) and regular follow-up re-testing.
Eligibility (Males aged 18 or above)
Patients diagnosed with penile cancer, anal cancer, or oropharyngeal cancer
Men with a history of sexually transmitted diseases (STD)
Men who have sex with men (MSM)
[
As there are too many participants, other groups will take priority.
]
Patients with chronic prostatitis / chronic pelvic pain syndrome (CPPS)
Study Location: Prince of Wales Hospital, Sha Tin
Narrative description
Urine sample + swabs (urethral, oropharyngeal, anal, coronal sulcus)
Complete a simple questionnaire
Optional: 20 ml blood sample (if required)
Free of Charge in HPV test !!
Upon successful completion of the study, participants will receive a
HKD 400
travel subsidy
Your Privacy is Fully Protected.
Data will only be used for academic research purposes.
If you are interested, please register via the link below:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf__iQ0Ike8hpG6qIm1mjtF0nCTdcPFKT2v9jFARsuZbqjMJw/viewform?usp=header
Suitable applicants will be contacted shortly.
For inquiries, please email:  timlau@surgery.cuhk.edu.hk

所收集的資料僅用於學術研究用途

Free HPV Screening for Men in Specific Groups [Free!!]
The Chinese University of Hong Kong Division of Urology Research Recruitment
The Department of Surgery (Urology), The Chinese University of Hong Kong is currently recruiting participants for a hybrid cohort and case-control study on male urinary HPV.
Human Papillomavirus (HPV) is one of the most common sexually transmitted viruses worldwide. It can affect men and lead to serious conditions including genital warts, penile cancer, anal cancer, and oropharyngeal cancer. However, HPV infection in men remains under-studied. Your cooperation is highly solicited.
This research aims to determine HPV prevalence, patient demographics, clinical characteristics, and disease burden in men. It will also evaluate the accuracy of a new urine-based HPV DNA test and explore risk factors to support future prevention and treatment strategies.
Participants who test positive for HPV in the initial urine test may be invited for further investigations (e.g. flexible cystoscopy) and regular follow-up re-testing.
Eligibility (Males aged 18 or above)
Patients diagnosed with penile cancer, anal cancer, or oropharyngeal cancer
Men with a history of sexually transmitted diseases (STD)
Men who have sex with men (MSM)
[
As there are too many participants, other groups will take priority.
]
Patients with chronic prostatitis / chronic pelvic pain syndrome (CPPS)
Study Location: Prince of Wales Hospital, Sha Tin
Narrative description
Urine sample + swabs (urethral, oropharyngeal, anal, coronal sulcus)
Complete a simple questionnaire
Optional: 20 ml blood sample (if required)
Free of Charge in HPV test !!

HKD 400
travel subsidy
Your Privacy is Fully Protected.

便秘？嗅覺變差？睡覺拳打腳踢？有腦退化家族史？
這些看似平常的小毛病，其實可能是柏金遜症等大腦退化的早期先兆！
提早了解大腦健康，預防神經退化！
中大醫學院睡眠研究小組推出全新手機篩查App，誠邀您參與醫學研究！
研究對象：
年齡介乎
50 至 65 歲
的華人
未確診
任何腦神經退化疾病（如柏金遜症、阿爾茲海默症/失智症等）
參加者需完成以下程序：
參與研究
費用全免
，成功完成相關研究程序者最多可獲
HK$300元超市禮券
作為津貼
